meta.verticalDatum: CGVD28 / GSD95 source elevations; per-building measured ground subtracted for flat terrain
meta.sourceRecordDateMeaning: DATE_ field values copied from the GDB; not independently verified acquisition dates
meta.wallOrientationMethod: Height-aware vertical roof-ray occupancy at 0.08, 0.2 and 0.6 metre horizontal wall-normal probes; only provably inward faces flipped
meta.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – City of Calgary.
meta.binaryFormat: 16-byte header (CGMESH1\0, uint32 recordCount, float32 quantization), then per-record int16 xyz vertices followed by uint16/uint32 triangle indices; little endian
limitations: Building roof and wall shape only; no facade photography or invented interior detail.
Survey age varies by structure. Newer or poorly matched footprints retain explicit fallback geometry.
Local ground is flattened per building; measured absolute ground elevations remain available in metadata.
Custom landmark replacements must be excluded by the renderer before requesting these models.
